title: Content.getComponent
body: Content.getComponent(String componentName) returns a reference to an existing scripted UI component with the supplied ID. Call it after the component has been created. Example: const var Knob1 = Content.getComponent("Knob1");. The ID is case-sensitive.

title: Synth.getEffect
body: Synth.getEffect(String name) returns a reference to an effect processor in the current module tree. Use the exact processor ID. The returned reference can be stored in a const var and used to access documented processor methods.

title: DspNetwork access
body: A Script Processor can obtain its DspNetwork with Engine.getDspNetwork(String id). Use DspNetwork.get(String nodeId) to retrieve a node by its exact ID. Both calls require IDs that already exist in the project.
